fact: On 14 May 2024 PAIX Data Centres announced a joint venture with the Fonds souverain de Djibouti to build JIB1, a 5 MW carrier-neutral data centre due in 2026, while the Djibouti Data Center (Tier 3, in service since 2013) is the country's only operational data centre.
title: Djibouti construit un 2e centre de données national
